Name: Sin's Haley Portraits
Author: synkinies
Description:
I decided to make a Haley mod as a passion project for Pride Month :3; Right now it's just for the base game outfits, but I plan on adding compatibility with the [b]Seasonal Outfits[/b] mod when I get the chance.

Working on compatibility for Content Patcher, for now, [b]please use with Portraiture[/b].

[list]
[*]for new mod users:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Go into your mods folder and find the [b]Portraiture[/b] folder, should look something like this: [u]D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture[/u]﻿
﻿ ﻿- Click into the [b]Portraits[/b] folder and draw my mod folder in, should look like this: [u]D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\Sin's Haley Portraits
[/u]
For further instructions, check the mod page of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]

Downloads.Description: Default, Beach, & Winter [fixed angry error in beach file]
